//: knip - MODULE-LEVEL dead-code detector (unused files, exports, dependencies) for a React Native app. Complements dependency-cruiser (cycles + boundaries) and the eslint no-unnecessary-condition rule (dead branches inside a file).
//entry: RN entry points: index.js (AppRegistry.registerComponent), App.tsx, and any *.native/.ios/.android platform variants. Navigation registries and lazy screen tables are the classic false-positive source (see //ignore).
//ignore: IMPORTANT PER-REPO TUNING. knip cannot see screens/components reached ONLY through a navigation registry (React Navigation route tables), a dynamic import(), or a string-keyed lazy table - it flags them as unused (false positive). Workflow is ANNOTATE, DO NOT DELETE: when knip flags a screen/component that IS wired through the navigator, add it here (or `// knip-ignore` the export). Deleting a real lazy/registered screen is how knip breaks navigation.
//ignoreDependencies: RN has native-only deps with no JS import (pods/gradle-linked). Add them to ignoreDependencies so knip does not report them as unused.
